Drury Honored to Join Leadership Group, Serve as Alternate Captain for Preds
GAME DAY: Preds at Maple Leafs, October 6

away.summary: The Nashville Predators are looking to build on their 2-1 victory over the Dallas Stars, with a win against the Toronto Maple Leafs serving as a key test. Justus Annunen is questionable for this game, while Vitali Pinchuk has joined the team after being recalled from the AHL.

home.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs are coming off a 3-2 loss to the Ottawa Senators, with a 1-2-0 record on the season. Auston Matthews and John Tavares are key players to watch, with Matthews scoring his first goal of the season in the loss. The team is looking to bounce back in this matchup against the Predators.
